name: Kakure Ecchi
source:
As winter break approaches New Year's, broke college student Sanjou Tomoya hurries home, eager to try out the new porn mag he bought. But the moment he starts getting busy in his room, his stepsister Megumi accidentally walks in. Though she initially freaks out, Megumi — now at that curious age — surprises him by asking to see more. Reluctantly giving in, Tomoya struggles to focus, prompting her to suggest a "show-and-tell" exchange.

The next day, their "momentum" carries them straight into a full-blown affair. Now addicted to the thrill, the siblings seize every chance to hook up while dodging their parents — groping under the kotatsu during family time, ambushing each other in the bathroom, sneaking into baths together, or even fooling around right behind their parents doing dishes while pretending to watch TV.

Then right before New Year's, relatives arrive. Tomoya's cousin catches them in the act — but instead of exposing them, her price for silence is... more sex. Now he has to satisfy both her and his jealous sister without either finding out. Humping at the shrine visit, using a remote-controlled vibrator under the kotatsu while everyone eats holiday food, making his sister climax on the kotatsu while his cousin sucks him off beneath it... how far will this chaos go?!

translation:
寒假临近新年，身无分文的大学生三条智也急忙回家，迫不及待地想尝试一下他买的新色情杂志。但就在他开始在房间里忙碌的时候，他的继妹惠意外地走进来。虽然惠美一开始很害怕，但惠——现在已经到了那个好奇的年龄——要求看更多东西，这让他大吃一惊。朋也不情愿地屈服，难以集中注意力，这促使她建议进行“展示和讲述”的交流。

第二天，他们的“势头”让他们直接陷入了一场全面的恋情。现在，兄妹俩沉迷于刺激，抓住一切机会勾搭，同时躲避父母——家庭时间在被炉下摸索，在浴室里互相伏击，一起偷偷溜进浴室，甚至一边假装看电视，一边在父母身后鬼混地洗碗。

过年前，亲戚们就来了。朋也的表弟当场抓住了他们——但她没有揭露他们，而是保持沉默的代价是……更多的性行为。现在他必须满足她和他嫉妒的妹妹，同时又不让任何人发现。参拜神社的时候，在大家吃节日食物的时候，在被炉下使用遥控振动器，让他的妹妹在被炉上达到高潮，而他的表弟则在被炉下给他口交……这种混乱会持续到什么程度？
